operations.title: Sector-indexed invariant-record algebras and the first composition obstruction
The current sector-indexed readout-algebra census has no admitted nonidentity morphism; the first radiative split-retraction candidate fails only at physical-constructor provenance
operations.body: A typed pullback requires a sourced equivariant substrate constructor, observable-subalgebra closure, physical-selection compatibility, and transport of support/chain/framing/coherence resources. The D3 memory centering d:P->V and zero-mean inclusion i:V->P give exact pullbacks with i*d*=id on Q[q2,q3], but the source does not independently type both as physical constructors, especially i. Thus the algebraic square is exact but not admitted. Cross-sector arrows remain absent and pi0 naturality remains untyped because no sourced psi_(n,s) family exists.

operations.title: Grothendieck returns the first exact readout-algebra composition obstruction
operations.body: Directed lane complete. I formalized the sector-indexed category: a constructor-induced pullback requires sourced F and phi with equivariance, pullback closure on the declared observable algebra, physical-selection compatibility, and support/chain/framing/coherence transport; arbitrary algebra maps are rejected. The first exact candidate is internal to radiative memory: centering d:Q^3->ker(e1) and zero-mean inclusion i induce d*(q2)=e1^2/3-e2, d*(q3)=e3-e1e2/3+2e1^3/27, i*(e1,e2,e3)=(0,-q2,q3), and i*d*=id. However it is not admitted: the source identifies the summands but does not independently declare both maps as physical constructors with selection compatibility, especially the inclusion. Therefore the present typed category still has no audited nonidentity arrows. Cross-sector maps remain absent; pi0 naturality is untyped because no sourced psi_(n,s) operation family exists. Packet/checker/result are under research/grothendieck/sector-indexed-invariant-record-algebras.*. No Phase II or Carrier multiplication.
